name: Avakaya (Andhra Mango Pickle)
instructions: 1. Wash and dry the raw mangoes thoroughly, then chop them into uniform cubes, keeping the hard kernel intact.
2. In a large bowl, mix mustard powder, red chili powder, and rock salt.
3. Add the mango pieces to the spice mix and coat them evenly.
4. Pour in the gingelly oil to ensure the pieces are well-submerged.
5. Add whole garlic cloves and fenugreek seeds.
6. Transfer the mixture to a clean, dry ceramic jar (bharani) and cover it tightly.
7. Let the pickle sit for 3 days, then stir well to ensure the salt and spices have dissolved, and it is ready to serve.
description: Avakaya is the quintessential pickle of Andhra Pradesh, representing the soul of the region's cuisine. It is prepared in large quantities during the summer season and is culturally significant as a staple accompaniment to hot rice and ghee, symbolizing home-cooked comfort and heritage.
